# serverroom_stock (Data Source)

Servers in stock now, ready to deliver, cheapest first, each with its order link. Read-only: an API key cannot order or pay, so a server is ordered by opening its order_url.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The three cheapest GPU servers in stock in New York or Miami.
data "serverroom_stock" "gpu" {
  location = ["New York", "Miami"]
  gpu      = ["RTX"]
  limit    = 3
}

output "cheapest_gpu_server" {
  value = data.serverroom_stock.gpu.servers[0].order_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `gpu` (List of String) GPU names, matched loosely ("RTX").
- `limit` (Number) How many to return, up to 40 (default 20).
- `location` (List of String) Cities or regions; "Amsterdam" matches "Amsterdam, EU".
- `max_price` (Number) At most this first-month price, in USD.
- `min_ram_gb` (Number) At least this much memory.
- `plan` (List of String) Plan codes, e.g. ["M710x", "D104"].

### Read-Only

- `servers` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (String)
- `disk` (String)
- `gpu` (String)
- `list_price` (Number) Monthly price from the second month on, when the first month is discounted; else equal to price.
- `location` (String)
- `name` (String) The machine's name, e.g. s924.
- `order_url` (String) The order page, prefilled with this machine.
- `os` (String) What is installed now; chosen again at order.
- `plan` (String)
- `price` (Number) First-month price in USD.
- `ram_gb` (Number)
- `server_id` (Number)
- `traffic` (String)
